.qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r5/rules/projects/webdev-task-template/task.toml, tests/Dockerfile, tests/.dockerignore, tests/test.sh, tests/tools/score.py, tests/tools/restart_mcp.py, tests/scoring.toml, tests/*/*/judge.toml
evidence: Static wiring conforms. task/task.toml:27-28 sets [verifier] environment_mode = "separate"; lines 30-35 [verifier.env] (REWARDKIT_JUDGE="claude-code", REWARDKIT_MODEL="z-ai/glm-5.3-flashx", ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL="https://openrouter.ai/api", ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN="${OPENROUTER_API_KEY}", ANTHROPIC_API_KEY="") diffs empty against the frozen block in staged-task-contract.md:66-74 and against the template task.toml (only [task]/[metadata] differ); [verifier.environment] network_mode="public" (no allowlist needed per SKILL.md:26). task/tests/Dockerfile is byte-identical to the template: pinned npm @anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.281, @openai/codex@0.151.0, @playwright/mcp@0.0.79, express@5.1.0, better-sqlite3@12.4.1, pip harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7, Chromium installed from the pinned Playwright CLI; COPY . /tests with go-rwx, so grading lives only in the separate verifier image (agent environment/Dockerfile copies only instructions/ and assets/). test.sh, score.py, restart_mcp.py, scoring.toml are identical to the template; test.sh:63-65 refuses to grade without REWARDKIT_JUDGE/MODEL. All five judge.toml files carry only the expected judge = "claude-code" fallback (line 5); grep for '^ *model *=' over task/tests returns nothing, and no reasoning effort/temperature in [judge]. Weak-app/alternative probe: no app can influence this wiring (tests not in agent image); a conforming app cannot be failed by it. Risk kept true because raw-evidence-index.json states a full configured grading run of these bytes is absent, so credential injection (OPENROUTER_API_KEY reaching the claude-code judge via OpenRouter) and verifier launch are not runtime-verified; base images are tag-pinned (node:22-bookworm-slim, python:3.12-slim) not digest-pinned and apt is unpinned, both template-controlled and NOTE-level only.
